module.name: roksbnkctl-cluster
module.description: Provision (or attach) the IBM Cloud ROKS cluster. Procedural container_image artifact run by the container engine; shares the deployment workspace with the other roksbnkctl phases.

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Cluster name (new) or existing cluster name/ID.

optional.name: cluster_create
optional.description: On = provision a NEW ROKS cluster. Off = attach to the existing cluster named in cluster_name.

optional.name: openshift_version
optional.description: OpenShift version for a new cluster (e.g. 4.18). Blank = roksbnkctl default.

optional.name: workers_per_zone
optional.description: Worker nodes per zone for a new cluster (e.g. 2). Blank = roksbnkctl default.

optional.name: cluster_vpc
optional.description: Adopt an existing cluster VPC by ID (new cluster lands in it). Blank = create one.

optional.name: install_bnk
optional.description: Install BIG-IP Next for Kubernetes.

optional.name: install_testing
optional.description: Deploy the testing phase.

optional.name: install_gateway
optional.description: Deploy the gateway phase.

optional.name: existing_transit_gateway
optional.description: Adopt an existing Transit Gateway by name/ID — the new cluster + testing VPC attach to it. Blank = create one.

optional.name: testing_vpc_name
optional.description: Name for the testing client VPC to create (testing phase). Blank = prefix-derived.

optional.name: bigip_url
optional.description: BIG-IP management URL for the BNK CIS controller (optional).

optional.name: bigip_username
optional.description: BIG-IP username for CIS (optional).

optional.name: bigip_password
optional.description: BIG-IP password for CIS (optional).

optional.name: zone1_ext_vlan_cidr
optional.description: Zone 1: external VLAN CIDR (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone1_int_vlan_cidr
optional.description: Zone 1: internal VLAN CIDR (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone1_int_snat_cidr
optional.description: Zone 1: internal SNAT CIDR (SNAT addresses) (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone1_int_vip_cidr
optional.description: Zone 1: internal VIP CIDR (listener IPs) (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone1_external_selfip
optional.description: Zone 1: external self-IP (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone1_internal_selfip
optional.description: Zone 1: internal self-IP (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).
